continue.description: Default true. false stops Claude entirely after the hook runs, and beats an event-specific decision. It does not by itself block a PreToolUse tool call.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false. It stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it later.

systemMessage.description: A warning shown to the user, not added to Claude's context. Capped at 10,000 characters; longer text is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000 character preview.

terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

additionalContext.description: Text added to Claude's context at the start of the conversation, before the first prompt, wrapped in a system reminder and not shown as a chat message. State facts rather than give commands. Capped at 10,000 characters.

initialUserMessage.description: Used as the first user message in non-interactive mode (-p), even when no prompt was passed.

sessionTitle.description: Sets the session title, like /rename. Applies when source is startup, resume or fork. Check session_title first to avoid overwriting one.

watchPaths.description: Absolute paths to watch for FileChanged events during this session.

reloadSkills.description: true re-scans the skill and command directories after the SessionStart hooks, for skills a hook just installed.

title: SessionStart hook output
description: Adds context and sets up the session. Cannot block. Plain-text stdout is added to Claude's context too, so a hook that only adds context need not print JSON.
